name: 0d3sa
description: Obsidian command center design system for the Agentic Team Protocol docs and site.
north_star: The site is a working command center for ATP. Every entry surface leads with the install/setup path, followed by roles and component reference. Dark obsidian ground, deep-abyss panels, graphite hairline borders, neon green primary actions, signal yellow illustration accents, status chips with colored dots.

tokens.css: :root { --obsidian: #132322; --abyss: #0e1a19; --charcoal: #070f0f; --graphite: #424f4f; --white: #ffffff; --slate: #828786; --neon: #3ddc91; --mint: #97ddbc; --yellow: #ffcd48; --mint-frost: #edf7f5; --fog: #d0d3d3; --radius-sm: 10px; --radius-md: 20px; --radius-lg: 60px; --radius-pill: 56px; --max: 1200px; --display: Chakra Petch, Saira, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; --body: Saira, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; --mono: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; }

button-primary.snippet: .btn.btn-primary { background: var(--neon); color: var(--obsidian); border-radius: 56px; } .btn.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--mint); }
button-primary.notes: Main call-to-action. Neon green pill with dark text.

button-secondary.snippet: .btn.btn-secondary { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--white); color: var(--white); border-radius: 56px; } .btn.btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
button-secondary.notes: Secondary action. Transparent pill with white border.

button-small.snippet: .btn.btn-sm { padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.82rem; background: var(--abyss); border: 1px solid var(--graphite); color: var(--slate); border-radius: 56px; } .btn.btn-sm:hover { border-color: var(--neon); color: var(--neon); }

status-chip-ready.snippet: .status-chip.ready { background: rgba(61,220,145,0.12); color: var(--neon); border: 1px solid rgba(61,220,145,0.3); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-family: var(--mono); } .status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
status-chip-ready.notes: Use for ready / active / success states. Always include a colored dot.

card.snippet: .card { background: var(--charcoal); border: 1px solid var(--graphite); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 20px; }
card.notes: Flat dark panel with 1px border and 20px radius. No heavy shadows.

card-large.snippet: .card-large { background: var(--abyss); border: 1px solid var(--graphite); border-radius: 60px; padding: 40px; }
card-large.notes: Large surface for install panels and major feature cards.

block-label.snippet: .block-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--slate); margin-bottom: 12px; }

command-block.snippet: .cmd { display: block; background: var(--obsidian); border: 1px solid var(--graphite); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 12px 14px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--white); overflow-x: auto; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 100%; }
command-block.notes: Copyable shell command in the call sheet.

copy-button.snippet: .copy-btn { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--obsidian); border: 1px solid var(--graphite); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--slate); } .copy-btn:hover { border-color: var(--neon); color: var(--neon); }
copy-button.notes: Icon-only button next to a command block.

site-header.snippet: .site-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--graphite); background: var(--obsidian); position: sticky; top: 0; height: 64px; }
site-header.notes: Sticky header with graphite hairline bottom border.

brand-mark.snippet: .brand-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--neon); color: var(--obsidian); display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 700; }
brand-mark.notes: Neon green square badge containing the 0 mark.

component-tag.snippet: .component-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(61,220,145,0.12); color: var(--neon); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-family: var(--mono); }
component-tag.notes: Small pill tag above component card names.

rules.name: One Neon Rule
rules.text: Neon green is reserved for the primary action and positive status. Do not use it for decorative accents.

rules.name: Status Dot Rule
rules.text: Every status chip must carry a solid dot in its text color.

rules.name: Monospace Is For Commands Rule
rules.text: JetBrains Mono appears only for shell commands, paths, tool names, and production labels.

rules.name: No Heavy Shadow Rule
rules.text: Depth comes from tonal layers, not drop shadows. Keep shadows subtle and functional.

rules.name: No Gradient Or Glass Rule
rules.text: No gradients, glass, blur, or ornamental decoration.

rules.name: No Emoji Icon Rule
rules.text: Use inline SVG or simple shapes for icons, never emoji or Unicode glyphs.

rules.name: Hairline Rule
rules.text: All dividing lines are 1px. Increase space, not stroke weight, if separation feels weak.

rules.name: No Duplicate H1 Rule
rules.text: In Starlight docs, rely on frontmatter title; do not repeat it with a markdown # heading.

narrative: A dark command-center world for the 0d3sa docs site. The dominant element on entry surfaces is the install/setup steps panel: copyable commands, role roster badges, and component reference cards. Headings are Chakra Petch, body is Saira, commands are JetBrains Mono. Palette is obsidian (#132322), deep abyss (#0e1a19), charcoal (#070f0f), graphite borders (#424f4f), neon green primary (#3ddc91), mint hover (#97ddbc), signal yellow illustration accent (#ffcd48). User-facing copy stays direct and operational.
